Congrats to my dear friend Deb Haaland on this resounding victory.

She’s a fierce fighter for working families and will be an outstanding Governor.


Deb Haaland (@DebHaalandNM)

New Mexico, thank you for believing in what we can build together. I’m honored to officially accept the Democratic nomination for Governor of New Mexico.





— https://nitter.net/DebHaalandNM/status/2061988375801049350#m

Trump is hurting students, families, and teachers by ripping important programs out of the Education Department.

We must protect students and save our schools.
highereddive.com/news/warren…

Tech executives are warning that AI could lead to “a level of wealth concentration that will break society.”

Those are their words.

I won’t accept that future.

Trump’s economy:

wsj.com/personal-finance/cre…

Trump promised to make life more affordable. He hasn't. He even said on TV he doesn't think about Americans' financial situations.

So I went directly to you. Real people. Real stories.

Video

Donald Trump is trading stocks in companies his government affects through policy decisions.

He’s holding the stocks while pulling the levers that determine their value.

It’s corruption, plain and simple.
Donald Trump wants to start one war, and then another war, and then another war. The American people are not looking for wars around the world; we are looking for lower prices here at home.

If we want to win in 2026 and 2028, Democrats need to take on the big fights.

Bring costs down.

End the corruption.

End the war in Iran.

Make life easier for working Americans.

No more hand-waving.

It's time to get serious.

Trump used the threat of a lawsuit against his own government to pressure nearly $2 billion out of the U.S. Treasury.

No jury decided this.

No judge approved it.

Congress never voted on it.

But your taxpayer dollars funded it.

AI was built on your creativity, your tax dollars, and your electric grid.

The profits shouldn't only flow to billionaires.

It's time to tax AI and invest in people.
time.com/article/2026/05/27/…

Donald Trump is rewriting the rules for his own benefit, and Republicans in Congress just let it happen.

Spineless doesn't begin to cover it.

We took an oath to the Constitution, not to Donald Trump.

Americans: We want to be able to afford health care, groceries, and gas.

Trump: Let me build a UFC fighting cage outside the White House.


Pop Crave (@PopCrave)

New photo of the UFC arena construction at the White House.





— https://nitter.net/PopCrave/status/2059422710757830683#m
Trump is more focused on trading corporate stocks than lowering the price of gas and groceries.

Trump’s government just gave him and his family immunity from tax prosecution. For life.

Which begs the question: What is Trump hiding in his taxes?

Video

I can’t believe I have to say this:

The President should not financially benefit from the very government he controls.

I’ve got a bill to stop Trump’s corruption.
